After months of shutting down engagement rumors and keeping their relationship relatively private, Rapper #LilWayne has seemingly taken things to the next level. 

He has reportedly introduced Madi, 23, as his fiancée, reigniting conversation around the couple and their relationship. The announcement is already getting attention — not only because of the reported engagement, but also because of the significant age gap between the two.

Lil Wayne is 43, making the reported age difference around 20 years, which has made the relationship somewhat controversial and sparked plenty of debate online. While some fans are questioning the age gap, others argue that both are consenting adults and that their relationship is ultimately their business.
